svg.title: Content Understanding Is Asynchronous
svg.desc: The app sends content with begin_analyze in the SDK or a POST to analyze over REST. The service replies 202 Accepted with an Operation-Location header and no fields yet; that is success, so don't re-POST. The app polls Operation-Location while it is running until it reports Succeeded; in the SDK, poller.result() waits. Then it reads the fields on result.contents, each with a confidence if estimateFieldSourceAndConfidence is enabled. Fields with confidence above the threshold go to the booking system; the rest go to human review.
svg.text: Hand it in, get a ticket, come back later: start, poll, then route fields by confidence.
begin_analyze(), or POST analyze over REST
A 202 with no fields is success: poll
